assertions.source: sympy simplify of y_lambda_at(n)[λ] for every ℓ(λ) ≥ 3 at n = 6, 9, 12; non-vanishing: {6: [], 9: [], 12: []}. This is what lets the series sum run over two-row partitions only.

assertions.name: series_order_zero_reproduces_the_derived_floor_c0
assertions.source: [ε⁰] of Δtr(1+ε) vs 2^-A - 2^(1-2A) as exact Fractions, all six cases. An independent re-derivation of ClassicalTraceFloor by the seminormal series rather than by cycle counting.

assertions.name: series_order_one_equals_the_six_recorded_rationals_exactly
assertions.source: [ε¹] of Δtr(1+ε) (= c1, since ε = ℏ_q + O(ℏ_q²)) vs the Richardson-measured rationals in PairwiseChainLeadingOrder.lean, Fraction equality: pp 19/8, pn 37/16, nn 9/4, T 163/64, 3He 85/32, 4He 259/128

assertions.name: permutation_formula_equals_exact_series_c1_for_all_six
assertions.source: c1 = 2^-n Σ_ℓ w_ℓ 2^c(σ^(ℓ)) over the free word minus the same over the atom word, w = +1 (σ), -1 (σ^-1), 0 (averaged), vs Part A's exact [ε¹]; Fraction equality in all six cases. This is the derivation [★], tested — a pure permutation count with no Hecke evaluation.

assertions.name: exact_fraction_pipeline_matches_transfer_kernel_at_q_8_over_7
assertions.source: Δtr at q = 8/7: exact Fraction via the asymmetric seminormal gauge + symbolic y_λ, vs tr_m_atom_zn(q=mpf(8)/7) at 50 dps, D/T/3He/4He. Ties the series pipeline to the witness path the six measurements came from.

assertions.name: colour_weight_first_enters_at_order_eps4
assertions.source: tr_M(atom) with the colour-weighted vs colour-blind p-n factor, deuteron: coefficients ε⁰..ε³ identical, ε⁴ differs by 1/6. δ = (q-1)²(1-q⁻⁴)/3 is O(ε³) and enters through h·δ = O(ε⁴), so c₁ (and c₂, c₃) are colour-blind.

assertions.name: closed_form_equals_permutation_count_for_every_ZN_with_A_2_to_20
assertions.source: c1(Z,N) = (21Z+16N)(2^(-A-1) - 2^(-2A)) - 4(I_pp - I_nn) 2^(-2A), I_pp = max(Z-1,0), I_nn = max(N-1,0), vs [★](free) - [★](atom) for all 228 (Z,N) with A = 2..20, Fraction equality. The 21 and 16 are the nucleon letter census 4·#σ - #σ⁻¹ (proton 6/3, neutron 5/4); the ±4 are the pp/nn interface letters.

description: The leading hbar_q coefficient c1 of tr_M(W_free) - tr_M(W_atom): computed EXACTLY as a power series in eps = q - 1 through the validated exact-Fraction seminormal pipeline (no Richardson), then DERIVED as a permutation count 2^-n sum_letters w_l 2^c(sigma with letter l deleted), w = +1/-1/0 for sigma/sigma^-1/averaged, by the same Schur-Weyl route that derived c0. The two agree exactly on all six recorded cases, and the derivation runs to A = 20.

derivation.1_first_order_generator: σ = s + ε(1 + Y) + O(ε²) with sY = -Ys, forced by σ² = hσ + 1, h = 2ε + O(ε²), s² = 1.
derivation.2_Y_is_trace_invisible: Tr(Y·P) = 0 for every permutation P: Y lives on the (e12,e21) sector of one adjacent pair, is traceless there with opposite off-diagonal entries, and the global spin flip commutes with every permutation, so the two sectors cancel.
derivation.3_normaliser_cancels: K' = 2 N_down, Tr(K' P) = n 2^c(P); (1+q²)^-n = 2^-n(1 - nε + …). The two n·2^c terms cancel.
derivation.4_letter_scalars: L_ℓ' = (1 + d_ℓ'(0))·1 with d'(0) = 0, -2, -1, -1 for σ, σ⁻¹, averaged, averaged_weighted; δ = O(ε³) is invisible.
derivation.result: d tr_M/dε|₀ = 2^-n Σ_ℓ w_ℓ 2^c(σ^(ℓ)), w = +1, -1, 0, 0; c1 = free - atom.
derivation.hypotheses_not_proved_here: quantum Schur-Weyl (tr_M = Tr(K ρ)/Z with K = diag(1,q²)^⊗n) — the same input ClassicalTraceFloor carries as a hypothesis; the rest is finite algebra.

data.verdict: c1 is DERIVED: the leading hbar_q coefficient of the trace difference is a signed sum over the word's non-averaged letters of 2^(c(σ with that letter deleted) - n), exactly like the floor c0 is 2^(c-n). Checked three ways — exact series, the permutation count, and the six Richardson measurements — all equal as Fractions. The six Lean definitions in PairwiseChainLeadingOrder.lean can become theorems conditional on Schur-Weyl.
